title: The magic square
summary: Can the king catch the pawn? Draw the square.

steps.md: Can the king catch the pawn? Draw a **square** from the pawn to the end. If the king can step in, he catches it!
The pawn on b4 makes this square (b4 to f8). The black king on g5 is outside.

steps.question: White to move. Can the black king catch the pawn?
steps.explain: No! The king is outside the square.

steps.question: White to move. Can the black king catch this pawn?
steps.explain: Yes, the king is close enough.

steps.prompt: Run, pawn, run! The king is outside the square.
